d:Hearth.XenotypeHospitalityDef/HH_XenoH: baseliner
Plain folk: sober tastes, careful with money. Large, thrifty groups.
sanguophage
Sanguophages want dark rooms and a hemogen minibar within reach. A deathrest lounge is something they will pay for.
hemogenic (any xenotype)
Anyone with the hemogenic gene, including custom xenotypes, shares the Sanguophage taste for dark rooms and hemogen packs.
UV-sensitive (any xenotype)
Sunlight hurts. A dark, indoor room is a comfortable room.
dirtmole
Dirtmoles prefer dark, windowless rooms and mushroom dishes. They offer to pay for a guided tour of the mine.
genie
Geniuses expect a reading nook and a quiet table. They rent research rooms.
hussar
Hussars spend freely at the bar and enjoy a good brawl, with the quarrels that come with it.
neanderthal
Big portions, simple rooms. Furnishing counts for less.
pigskin
Pigskins eat almost anything and do not mind a messy room.
impid
Impids like warm rooms and spice. They perform for a share of the takings.
waster
Wasters feel at home in dirty rooms, spend a lot and leave a mess.
yttakin
Yttakin want cold rooms; warm ones make them miserable.
highmate
Highmates love beauty and company. Handsome shared rooms please them.
